correctness.rationale: For every integer d≥4 the degree-three harmonic SO(2)×SO(d−2) separation gives exhaustive orthogonal blocks of sizes four, three, two and one. Exact beta moments give η₀²=(d−2)/(3(d+2)) and η₁²=d/(2(d+2)), both positive. The mask Fourier coefficients are 2/π at order two, −2/(3π) at order six and zero at order four; their block characteristic polynomials give all nine eigenvalues. The multiplicities total d(d−1)(d+4)/6, the protected 1/2 multiplicity equals binomial(d,3), and strict inequalities give the sharp stability constant for all d. The packaged symbolic checker passed exact beta ratios, characteristic polynomial, multiplicities and key ordering; a separately computed full projected-monomial Gram matrix matched the entire spectra for d=3,...,8 within 3.7e−15. Finite tests are crosschecks, not infinite proofs.

value.rationale: A full natural Laplace eigenspace on S^(d−1), rather than an arbitrary narrow monomial family, is observed over a canonical disconnected two-lune half-area region. The theorem classifies all sharp energy eigenvalues and their eigenspaces at every d≥4, identifies the exact binomial(d,3) half-energy sector and proves dimension-uniform sharp reconstruction conditioning with a monotone limiting constant. The complete invariant and its stability law are nontrivial and directly relevant to angular-mask harmonic reconstruction; neither just a numeric example nor a mere restatement of an abstract spectral problem.
